_comment: API-LLM backend for RS2 (run_rs2.py --api). Any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint works: OpenRouter (any model incl. GPT/Claude/DeepSeek/Qwen), OpenAI, DeepSeek, Groq, Together, xAI. Put the key in RS2 Local/.secrets.json under the name in api_key_name — never in this file.
_max_tokens_note: per-stage output cap; run_rs2 overrides to 16384 for the final 13-section report
_extra_headers_note: OpenRouter optionally wants HTTP-Referer/X-Title; harmless to leave empty
